description: A link to the business's booking website with the branch, service or package, professional and, optionally, an open start time pre-selected (the time is re-checked first). The booking, the customer's details and any payment are completed on the website.

branch.description: Branch id or name to pre-select.
branch.title: Branch

business.description: The business's `business` value, as given in search results.
business.title: Business

date.description: Day of the chosen start time, YYYY-MM-DD, branch local. Give with time.
date.title: Date

language.description: Site language code: en, ar, tr, ru or de. Defaults to the business's default language.
language.title: Language

option.description: Option id or name of the service, used to check the time when the service has options. The customer still picks the option on the site.
option.title: Option

package.description: Package id or name to pre-select instead of a service.
package.title: Package

service.description: Service id or name to pre-select. Give this or package, or neither for the plain booking page.
service.title: Service

staff.description: Professional's staff id or name to book with.
staff.title: Staff

time.description: Chosen start time, HH:MM (24h), branch local, one of the business's open start times. Give with date; needs a service or package.
time.title: Time

name: get_booking_link
title: Booking link
